reports.title: 6-DOF Neutral Equilibrium & 72-Muscle Tonic Balance (u0)
reports.scenario: All reflexes & voluntary OFF (enable_vcr=F, enable_ccr=F, enable_task=F, enable_antibuckling=F); 1.0s quiet stance from q=0.

checks.expected: max |qddot(0)| < 1.0 deg/s^2
|pitch(1.0s)| < 0.25 deg
|roll|, |yaw| < 0.05 deg

reports.title: Kuo (2019) DynamicLigamentForce Bilinear Elasticity & Rate Scaling
reports.scenario: Prescribe slow (-35 deg in 0.8s) vs fast (-35 deg in 0.08s) flexion; probe posterior LF/ISL/CL ligament strain, strain_rate, tension.

checks.expected: tension == 0 when strain <= 1.0
F_static (LF_r_spine_cerv7) matches analytical 4.97 N (±5%)
F_fast > F_slow at matched mid-strain (log rate scaling)

reports.title: Cross-Bridge Short-Range Stiffness (SRS) & Rest-Gated Thixotropy
reports.scenario: Stretch splen_cap_sklc6 via rapid flexion (-6 deg in 40ms) with SRS ON vs OFF, then oscillate ±15 deg (breakdown) and rest 0.6s (recovery).

checks.expected: F_tendon(SRS ON) > F_tendon(SRS OFF) + 0.08 N on rapid stretch at tonic a0=0.023
srs_thix drops during continuous ±14 deg oscillation (thix_min < 0.70)
srs_thix recovers upward during quiet rest (end > min_osc + 0.10)

reports.title: Mileusnic (2006) Spindle Primary Ia & Secondary II (+ Fusimotor)
reports.scenario: Ramp-and-hold flexion (-15 deg in 0.20s, hold to 0.65s) on splen_cap_sklc6 under (K_gd=0,K_gs=0) vs (K_gd=1,K_gs=0) vs (K_gd=0,K_gs=1).

checks.expected: Ia_peak > Ia_hold > Ia_base (velocity sensitivity)
II_hold > II_base (static length encoding)
gamma_d=1 boosts Ia ramp peak without shifting II
Active alpha-gamma coactivation (K_gs=1 vs 0) elevates static II > +2 imp/s

reports.title: Lin & Crago (2002) Golgi Tendon Organ (GTO) Group Ib Afferent
reports.scenario: Isometric neck (all 6 DOFs locked at 0); command sustained pitch extension torque via desired_pitch=+25 deg (u=1) so extensor tendon force jumps; probe tendon_Ib vs F_T.

checks.expected: tendon_Ib rises strongly when tendon force rises
Ib exhibits Lin02 dynamic overshoot (peak >= end)
Ib(t) matches exact Lin02 2-pole ODE (128.4 imp/s, end err < 3%, RMS < 3 imp/s)

checks.expected: luen_omega[0] = +0.349 rad/s (±8%), xtalk < 12%
luen_omega[1] = +0.349 rad/s (±8%), xtalk < 12%

reports.title: Canal Luenberger Observer & Velocity-Storage Integrator

checks.expected: luen_omega_yaw(3s) ~ 17.96 deg/s (±5%)
luen+vs(3s) ~ 29.09 deg/s (±5%, exact coupled VS ODE) and > luen+5

reports.title: 3D Otolith Maculae (Regular Luenberger & Irregular Lead/Adaptation)

checks.expected: +20 deg Pitch -> delta f_x = +3.36 m/s^2 (±12%)
+20 deg Roll -> delta f_z = -3.36 m/s^2 (±12%)

cuneate_roll tracks static true (+9.2 deg) within ±12%, cross-axis err < 1.0 deg
cuneate_yaw tracks static true (+9.2 deg) within ±12%, cross-axis err < 1.0 deg
